# YAM Logistics Pvt. Ltd.

> Licensed customs broker (CBIC licence R-7/92, since 1992) and international freight forwarder in New Delhi, India, with offices in Mumbai and Mundra. Customs clearance, ocean and air freight, project cargo and trade compliance for Indian importers and exporters, with particular depth in India–Russia/CIS, Gulf and third-country trade and in mobile phone exports.

Company history: the family group began in Kanpur in 1962 (Pacific Travels) and entered shipping in 1968. The company was incorporated in Delhi in 1987 as H.E. Hussain & Sons Pvt. Ltd. (CIN U74899DL1987PTC027852), received its customs broker licence in 1992 and was renamed YAM Logistics Pvt. Ltd. in 2011. Managing Director: Razi Zaheer. Contact: info@yamlogistics.com, +91 11 4160 3301, E-51 Kalkaji, New Delhi 110019.

The free tools below are provided for guidance only; each page carries its own disclaimer and data sources.

## Company

- [Home](https://www.yamlogistics.com/): Licensed customs broker (R-7/92) and freight forwarder. Ocean, air and project cargo, mobile phone exports from Mumbai airport 24×7, and duty-free third-country re-exports through India.
- [About YAM Logistics](https://www.yamlogistics.com/about): From Kanpur in 1962 to customs desks across India. The story, people and principles behind YAM Logistics.
- [Contact](https://www.yamlogistics.com/contact): Talk to a licensed customs broker. WhatsApp @YAMLOGISTICS, call +91 11 4160 3301 or visit our offices in New Delhi, Mumbai and Mundra.
- Telegram: https://t.me/YAMLOGISTICS (@YAMLOGISTICS)

## Services

- [Air freight](https://www.yamlogistics.com/air-freight): Air export and import through Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Ahmedabad. Dangerous goods, AOG, charters and a 24×7 desk at Sahar Air Cargo.
- [Ocean freight](https://www.yamlogistics.com/ocean-freight): Full and part container shipping through Nhava Sheva, Mundra and ICD Dadri, cleared under our own customs licence. One desk from origin to your door.
- [Customs brokerage](https://www.yamlogistics.com/customs-brokerage): Import and export customs clearance at 14 stations across India: bill of entry, shipping bill, HS classification, duty, BIS/FSSAI permissions and export schemes.
- [Mobile phone export logistics](https://www.yamlogistics.com/mobile-phone-exports): Mumbai airport’s #1 mobile phone export forwarder. Shipping bills, lithium battery DG paperwork, IMEI reconciliation and same-night uplift from all major Indian airports.
- [Third-country trade logistics](https://www.yamlogistics.com/third-country-trade): Import into an Indian customs-bonded warehouse or FTWZ, store or repack, and re-export to a third country without paying Indian import duty. Run end to end by a licensed broker.
- [Buyer's consolidation](https://www.yamlogistics.com/buyers-consolidation): Buying from several Indian suppliers? We follow up every purchase order, collect from each factory, check and consolidate the goods, and ship them together in one container or air shipment.
- [Project cargo](https://www.yamlogistics.com/project-cargo): Plant machinery, heavy-lift and over-dimensional cargo, with route surveys, permits and project-import clearance under heading 9801.
- [Bonded warehousing](https://www.yamlogistics.com/bonded-warehousing): Store imports in an Indian customs-bonded warehouse or FTWZ, defer duty, clear lot by lot or re-export duty-free. Into-bond and ex-bond filings by a licensed broker.
- [Cargo insurance](https://www.yamlogistics.com/cargo-insurance): All-risks marine cargo insurance (ICC A, B, C), open covers and inland transit cover arranged with IRDAI-licensed insurers, with claims support from a licensed customs broker.
- [Logistics for complex regions](https://www.yamlogistics.com/complex-regions): Routes to landlocked, remote and hard-to-reach markets via the right transit hubs, with partner agents and sanctions screening.
- [Dangerous goods shipping](https://www.yamlogistics.com/dangerous-goods): Classification, UN packaging, labels and DG declarations for lithium batteries, chemicals, paints and gases by air and sea.
- [Destination delivery order agency](https://www.yamlogistics.com/destination-do-agency): India agency for overseas forwarders and NVOCCs: pre-alerts, IGM, delivery orders, customs clearance and door delivery.
- [Emergency and relief cargo](https://www.yamlogistics.com/emergency-relief-cargo): Relief goods, medicines and emergency equipment moved fast by charter, air, sea and road for governments, NGOs and aid agencies, 24x7.
- [Exhibition cargo and ATA Carnet](https://www.yamlogistics.com/exhibition-ata-carnet): Duty-free temporary import of exhibition goods into India on an ATA carnet or bond, delivery to Bharat Mandapam, Yashobhoomi and Mumbai venues, and return after the show.
- [Expedited shipping](https://www.yamlogistics.com/expedited-shipping): Next-flight-out air freight, AOG, charters and dedicated trucks for time-critical cargo, with customs cleared under our own licence.
- [Haulage and ICD movements](https://www.yamlogistics.com/haulage-icd): Road and rail container haulage between Nhava Sheva, Mundra, ICD Tughlakabad, ICD Dadri and your factory, with ODC trailers and ICD clearance.
- [Live animal shipping](https://www.yamlogistics.com/live-animals): Horses, livestock, birds, fish and zoo animals moved by air under IATA Live Animals Regulations, with quarantine and CITES paperwork.
- [Perishable cargo](https://www.yamlogistics.com/perishables): Cold-chain air and reefer shipping for mangoes, grapes, vegetables, seafood and flowers, with phytosanitary and health certificates.
- [Pet relocation](https://www.yamlogistics.com/pet-relocation): Dogs and cats relocated with their families: health certificates, quarantine NOC, IATA crates, pet-friendly flights and arrival clearance.
- [Pharmaceutical logistics](https://www.yamlogistics.com/pharmaceuticals): Temperature-controlled shipping for medicines, APIs, vaccines and clinical supplies, with data loggers and CDSCO paperwork.
- [Supply chain consulting](https://www.yamlogistics.com/supply-chain-consulting): Landed-cost modelling, duty and FTA planning, port and route choice, and bonded or FTWZ strategy, from a licensed customs broker and forwarder.
- [Trade compliance](https://www.yamlogistics.com/trade-compliance): IEC, Advance Authorisation, EPCG, RoDTEP and drawback, HS classification, BIS and FSSAI approvals, and replies to customs notices.
- [Aircraft charter](https://www.yamlogistics.com/aircraft-charter): Full and part freighter charters and on-board couriers for urgent, outsize and humanitarian cargo, cleared under our own licence.
- [Sea-air logistics](https://www.yamlogistics.com/air-sea-bridge): Combine ocean and air in one shipment: sea to Dubai, Colombo or Singapore, then air to the final destination. Cheaper than air, faster than sea, ideal for landlocked countries.

## Free tools

- [AWB label generator](https://www.yamlogistics.com/awb-label-generator): Free air waybill label generator: create barcoded IATA Resolution 606 cargo labels for every piece, with destination, pieces, weight and house waybill, as a print-ready PDF for 4x6 thermal, 10x15 cm or A4.
- [Container sizes guide](https://www.yamlogistics.com/container-sizes): Free plain-language guide to shipping container sizes: inside and outside dimensions, door openings, tare, payload and max gross weight for 20ft, 40ft, 40ft high cube, 45ft, reefer, open top, flat rack and ISO tank containers, including in-gauge vs out-of-gauge cargo, with downloadable PDF spec sheets.
- [How we use AI](https://www.yamlogistics.com/how-we-use-ai): How YAM Logistics uses AI for HSN classification, duty calculation, document reading and tracking, and where a licensed customs broker (licence R-7/92) takes over: a person checks and signs every filing.
- Free tracker upload: on https://www.yamlogistics.com/track-shipment visitors can upload an air waybill copy (PDF or photo); the AWB number is read in the browser and routed to the airline's own tracking, with a downloadable branded tracking summary.
- [CBM and volumetric weight calculator](https://www.yamlogistics.com/cbm-calculator): Free CBM calculator: enter carton sizes to get total volume, air chargeable weight (÷6000), LCL W/M and container fit for 20′, 40′ and 40′ HC.
- [Container load calculator](https://www.yamlogistics.com/container-load-planner): Free container load calculator: enter your packages and see how many 20′, 40′ or 40′ HC containers, pallets or air pallets you need, with a 3D view, step-by-step loading sequence and PDF plan.
- [Import duty calculator](https://www.yamlogistics.com/customs-duty-calculator): Free India import duty calculator: search 12,000+ HSN tariff lines by code or description, choose the country of origin and see BCD, social welfare surcharge, IGST, landed cost and DGFT import policy.
- [Dangerous goods labels library](https://www.yamlogistics.com/dg-labels): Download 51 printable dangerous goods and special cargo labels: UN3481/UN3480 lithium battery marks, Class 1–9 hazard labels, Class 9A, Cargo Aircraft Only, limited and excepted quantity marks, perishable, live animals and Time & Temperature Sensitive labels. Free PDF, PNG and SVG.
- [Export benefit finder](https://www.yamlogistics.com/export-benefit-finder): Free export incentive calculator for India: enter your HS code and FOB value to see the duty drawback (AIR), RoDTEP or RoSCTL rate and cap, and DGFT export policy, from the latest CBIC and DGFT notifications.
- [HSN code finder](https://www.yamlogistics.com/hsn-code-finder): Free HSN code finder for India: describe your product in plain words and see likely 8-digit HSN / ITC(HS) codes from the Customs Tariff, with basic customs duty and import and export policy for each.
- [Incoterms 2020 chart](https://www.yamlogistics.com/incoterms): Free interactive Incoterms 2020 chart: see who pays and who carries the risk at every step for EXW, FCA, FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU and DDP, with tips for Indian importers and exporters.
- [Lithium battery checker](https://www.yamlogistics.com/lithium-battery-checker): Free lithium battery checker for air cargo: find the UN number, IATA packing instruction (PI 965–970), Section I or II, state-of-charge limit, documents and labels in 30 seconds.
- [Shipment tracker](https://www.yamlogistics.com/track-shipment): Free container and air waybill tracking for 55+ shipping lines and 400 airlines, plus the Indian port, CFS, ICD and rail leg. Paste any container, AWB or B/L number.
- [All free tools](https://www.yamlogistics.com/free-tools): Free tools from a licensed customs broker: import duty calculator, export benefit finder (drawback, RoDTEP), container load calculator, CBM calculator, lithium battery checker, DG labels, Incoterms chart and shipment tracking.
